name: Agents Explanation: From Chatbots to Autonomous Systems
description_md:
What You Get:

- 
A PDF of the Deck: As featured in the YouTube video, this deck covers the key insights on AI agents.

- 
Clear Definitions: Understand what "agentic" means and the spectrum of AI agency.

- 
Actionable Frameworks: Practical models like Agent Buffets, Supervisor-Agent workflows, and hierarchical systems.

- 
Insights on Limitations: Common flaws like miscommunication, prompt issues, and tool errors in agent systems.

- 
Future Outlook: What’s needed to achieve fully autonomous agents and their ideal workflows.

- 
Cheat Sheet: A summary of agent types, from chatbots to collaborative multi-agent systems.

Perfect for developers, AI enthusiasts, and business leaders looking to dive into the world of AI agents.
